name: manual_ace375
claim: Correction to the 2026-11-15T09:56:41Z recovery record: run start.sh on Mac and start.ps1 on Windows for the respective launcher steps; the recorded same-LAN prerequisite is session-specific and not an established universal delivery requirement. The pin history conflicts: one entry says the local value was already a DER digest, another says it changed from a raw-file hash; the available records do not establish which is true, so both the alleged repair and the root-cause wording at 2026-11-15T11:05:00Z remain unverified. That latter entry reports outbox delivery over pinned-CA TLS and an opposite-direction inbox arrival; it does not establish the transport of that arrival independently or content identity in either direction. Verify each receiver-computed digest against its sender digest and label both raw-byte or LF-normalized before claiming content-verified reciprocal delivery.

decisions.notes: PR 517 review: preserve the original entries, distinguish reported observations from independently established facts, and avoid recording certificate or token values.
